metadata.title: Ambur Chicken Biryani
metadata.description: There is a huge Northeastern community of students and professional in Chennai and for most of us Chennai is like our second home. If you're one of those who have studied or worked in Chennai, you could not have missed out on the 'Oh so awesome!' biryani. My favorite has always been the Ambur Star Biryani. Here's a video on step by step way to make your own tasty Ambur biryani.
